messages.text: What evidence is required to compare our Vector Network Analyzer solution with a competitor for Semiconductor without making unsupported claims?

- 【推論】Current evidence gives Semiconductor-adjacent VNA opportunities for Bare Board for SoCs / RFIC and PCB probing [39][46], and a separate Keysight ENA competitor case for LSmtron board-to-board connector testing [45], so a supported Semiconductor competitor comparison needs one source tying the same opportunity to both our VNA solution and the competitor.
The source should name the Semiconductor application or DUT, because existing Semiconductor-adjacent evidence only identifies Bare Board for SoCs, PCB probing, impedance, insertion loss, return loss, socket evaluation and transmission-line evaluation [39][46].
The source should name the exact R&S VNA solution and bundle, because existing project evidence names ZNB40, probe, mount-kit and de-embedding tool as the offered solution for PCB probing [46].
The source should name the exact competitor in the same use case, because existing competitor evidence names Keysight ENA only in the LSmtron board-to-board connector case [45].
Any R&S numeric claim needs the exact product, configuration and specification source, because ZNA67EXT is a 10 MHz to 110 GHz 1.0 mm VNA system based on ZNA67 with up to four external test sets [2][4].
Any ZNA67EXT claim must respect the stated configuration restriction, because its specifications apply only when the system configuration matches the R&S ZNA67 rear-panel designation scheme for type, serial numbers and correct port positions [4].
Any measurement-performance claim needs the stated test conditions, because ZNA67EXT product data assumes three hours of storage, 90 minutes of warm-up, specified environmental conditions, calibration interval compliance and applicable internal automatic adjustments [4].
Any dynamic-range comparison must use the same conditions, because ZNA67EXT dynamic range is specified at 10 Hz measurement bandwidth, with short-circuited test ports, no user correction, and specified port-pair limits only for port 1–2 and port 3–4 on 4-port models [7].
Any claim must separate warranted specifications from non-guaranteed data, because specifications with limits are warranted while typical data, nominal values, measured values and non-traceable specifications with limits are not guaranteed by R&S [4][38].
Competitor technical claims need official competitor evidence, because the Anritsu page says frequency range, bandwidth, data rate, option code, software tools and support model require Anritsu official datasheets, release notes or support terms for verification [23].
Sales-positioning claims should not be used as technical proof, because R&S superiority, only-vendor and lower-TCO statements are described as sales positioning rather than directly citeable technical specifications [23].
The 112G PAM4 PCB Engineering source is insufficient for a VNA comparison because it lacks test flow, instrument models, frequency range, fixture, calibration method, measurement values and pass/fail conditions [48].

ZNA67EXT_specs_en_5216-3743-22_v0900 › 重點摘要
這份來源是 [[R&S ZNA67EXT]] Vector Network Analyzer System 的 specifications，文件標示為 **PD 5216.3743.22 | Version 09.00 | July 2025 (ja)**，頁首也標示 **Version 09.00, July 2025**。

[[R&S ZNA67EXT]] 是 1.0 mm [[Vector Network Analyzer]] system，涵蓋 **10 MHz to 110 GHz**。系統由一台 [[R&S ZNA67]] vector network analyzer 與最多四個 external test sets 組成；來源說明規格只對照 R&S ZNA67 rear panel designation scheme 中 type、serial numbers 與正確 port 位置完全一致的 system configuration 有效。

主要產品資訊：

- Impedance：**50 Ω**。
- Test port connector：**1.0 mm, male**。
- Number of test ports：models **.12/.13/.15/.16** 為 **2**；models **.14/.17** 為 **4**。
- Frequency range：**10 MHz to 110 GHz**。
- Frequency resolution：**1 Hz**。
- Number of measurement points：user-selectable **1 to 100001**。
- Measurement bandwidths：**1 Hz to 1.5 MHz**，1/1.5/2/3/5/7 steps。
- Calibration interval：**1 year**。

Effective system data 條件：valid between **+18 °C and +28 °C**，temperature after calibration varied by no more than **1 °C**；frequency points、measurement bandwidth、sweep time 必須與 calibration identical，no interpolation；measurement bandwidth **10 Hz**，nominal source power **–10 dBm**；calibration kit 為 [[R&S ZN-Z210]]。

Test port input noise 條件：**1 kHz measurement bandwidth, normalized to 1 Hz**。來源 footnote 5 說 different bandwidth add `[10 × log10(bandwidth / 1Hz)]` to the given noise level。

Anritsu
[[Anritsu]] 是一間日本 test & measurement vendor；在 [[2026_02_CMX500_Anritsu_Sales_Battle_Card]] 中被描述為 R&S radio communication tester portfolio 的競品供應商。

Anritsu › Battle card 中的公司輪廓
依 [[2026_02_CMX500_Anritsu_Sales_Battle_Card]]（2026-02-26）：

- Headquarters：Kanagawa, Japan。
- Company size：約 4,000+ employees global。
- Market positioning：source 稱其在 Japan T&M market share 為 #1，但 global footprint 較弱。
- Strengths：good LTE/eCall signaling（[[Anritsu MD8475B]]）、solid RF heritage、strong Japanese operator relationships。
- Support model：traditional hardware service；source 評為 software ecosystem 較弱、cloud capabilities limited，且 TestDeck 是唯一 DX tool。

以上為 R&S internal battle card 對競品的描述；來源未引用 Anritsu 官方文件或第三方市場資料。

Anritsu › 來源列出的產品組合
| 產品 / 平台 | 來源描述 | 限制 |
|---|---|---|
| [[Anritsu MT8000A]] | 5G NR FR1 / FR2 / FR3 | source 稱需 separate RF boards、external mmWave converters、multiple boxes；未列 Anritsu datasheet 版次 |
| [[Anritsu MD8475B]] | LTE / IMS / eCall | source 稱是 Anritsu strength之一 |
| [[Anritsu MT8821C]] | LTE / LTE-A / 3G / 2G RF | source 稱 LTE RF requires MT8821C |
| [[Anritsu MT8862A]] | Wi-Fi | source 稱 MT8000A 無 WLAN signaling，Wi-Fi 需 separate tester |
| [[Anritsu MT8852B]] | Bluetooth | source 僅列入 portfolio，未展開規格 |

Anritsu › Battle card 中的弱點敘事
[[2026_02_CMX500_Anritsu_Sales_Battle_Card]] 對 Anritsu 的主要弱點敘事如下：

- Fragmented hardware architecture：FR1 / FR2 / FR3 需多 RF boards；source 列 boards 021/022/023/024/031/032/033，另一處另列 041。
- Early multi-box dependency：FR2、high CA、mobility 被描述為 often require multiple MT8000As。
- No integrated fading / external IP tools：source 稱 IP Option 012 + external PC；fading 需要 external PC software / chambers / software。
- Software fragmentation：SSNR、RTD、ATS、MX844030PC 被描述為 disconnected tools。
- LTE RF requires [[Anritsu MT8821C]]：source 稱 MT8000A cannot replace MT8821C for legacy RF。
- FR3 headroom：source 稱 Anritsu FR3 module supports only 0.4–16 GHz，限制 future 6G / FR3 evaluations beyond 16 GHz。

Anritsu › 使用限制
- 本頁目前只依 R&S 內部 battle card 建立；不能把 source 對 Anritsu 的弱點敘事視為 Anritsu 官方規格或市場事實。
- Anritsu 產品的 frequency range、bandwidth、data rate、option code、software tools 與 support model 需要另以 Anritsu 官方 datasheet / release notes / support terms 驗證。
- 來源中出現的 R&S superiority / only vendor / lower TCO 等語句屬 sales positioning，不是可直接引用的技術規格。

R&S ZNA › Key performance（Version 24.00）
- Dynamic range：> 129 dB specification without options；147 dB typical with options；maximum attainable range up to 170 dB allowing full 2-port correction。
- Sensitivity：> –120 dBm，1 Hz IF bandwidth，specification without options；–162 dBm，1 Hz IF bandwidth，measured with options。來源註明 –162 dBm 是以 1 kHz measurement bandwidth 量測後 normalized to 1 Hz。
- Power sweep range：100 dB typical continuous electronic sweep range；可使用 mechanical step attenuators 位移 sweep range。
- Source power linearity：0.2 dB typical，範圍 –40 dBm to +10 dBm。
- Receiver compression：0.05 dB typical，up to +8 dBm at test port，referenced to –10 dBm。
- Trace noise：0.005 dB specification RMS、0.002 dB typical RMS，條件為 10 GHz、100 kHz measurement bandwidth、0 dB reflection。
- Speed example：10 MHz to 43.5 GHz、500 kHz measurement bandwidth、1601 points、2-port calibration 時 sweep time 96 ms nominal。

R&S ZNA › Internal PC 與介面
- Internal PC：Removable PC IPS 15/8；CPU AMD R2000；clock rate 3.35 GHz to 3.7 GHz；RAM 16 Gbyte DDR4；operating system Windows 11 IoT Enterprise 2024 LTSC；SSD ≥ 256 Gbyte。
- 來源註明：Internal PC is subject to change without notice。
- Main screen：touchscreen，30.7 cm diagonal，WXGA，18-bit color LCD；resolution 1280 × 800 pixel，125 dpi。
- Auxiliary screen：touchscreen，17.8 cm diagonal，WVGA，18-bit color LCD；resolution 480 × 800 pixel，125 dpi。
- Front panel USB：USB 2.0 device connector（type A），3 個。
- Rear panel：GPIB interface、LAN 1 Gbit/s、USB 2.0 type A 4 個、USB device type B 1 個、DVI-D、DisplayPort。
- REF IN：BNC female，1 MHz to 50 MHz，1 Hz step，100 Ω；SMA female，100 MHz or 1 GHz，fixed frequency，50 Ω；input power –10 dBm to +15 dBm。
- REF OUT：BNC female，10 MHz，50 Ω，output frequency accuracy 1 Hz，output power +9 dBm ± 4 dB。
- Trigger In A：BNC female，TTL edge-triggered 或 level-triggered，3 V、5 V tolerant；minimum pulse width 1 µs；input impedance 5 kΩ nom.。

R&S ZNA › 重要 recommended setups
- [[R&S ZNA-K5]] vector corrected converter measurements：recommended setup 為 4-port R&S®ZNA；需要 R&S®ZNA-K4、R&S®ZNA-B5、R&S®ZNA-B8 mmWave converter LO、R&S®ZN-ZM292 calibration mixer 與 calibration accessories。
- [[R&S ZNA-K8]] mmWave converter support：two mmWave converters with 2-port R&S®ZNA，或 four mmWave converters with 4-port R&S®ZNA；需要 R&S®ZNA-K8、R&S®ZNA-B8、R&S®ZNA-B26、R&S®ZCAKN 與 accessories。Alternative setup：two mmWave converters with 4-port R&S®ZNA，需要 R&S®ZNA-K8、R&S®ZNAxx-B16、R&S®ZCAKN 與 accessories。
- [[R&S ZNA-K9]] group delay measurements：4-port R&S®ZNA recommended setup 需要 R&S®ZNAxx-B213、R&S®ZNA-B5、R&S®ZNA-K9；2-port R&S®ZNA recommended setup 需要 R&S®ZNAxx-B212、R&S®ZNAxx-B52、R&S®ZNA-K9。
- [[R&S ZNA-K30]] noise figure measurement：recommended setup 使用 port 1 as driving and port 2 as receiving port；需要 R&S®ZNAxx-B16、R&S®ZNAxx-B21、R&S®ZNAxx-B32、R&S®ZNAxx-B161、R&S®ZNAxx-B302、diode power sensor（例如 R&S®NRP40S）與 accessories（test cables、fixed attenuators 3 dB / 6 dB / 10 dB 等）。

  - [[R&S ZNA26]]：10 MHz to 26.5 GHz。

- 各型號提供 2 ports 或 4 ports base unit；test port impedance 為 50 Ω，DC block 為 standard。
- Key performance 包含：dynamic range > 129 dB specification without options、147 dB typical with options、maximum attainable range up to 170 dB allowing full 2-port correction；sensitivity > –120 dBm at 1 Hz IF bandwidth specification without options，並有 –162 dBm measured with options（1 kHz measurement bandwidth normalized to 1 Hz）。

ZNA_specs_en_5215-4652-22_v2400 › 規格條件與資料定義
- Specifications with limits：表示 warranted product performance；以 <、≤、>、≥、±、maximum、limit of、minimum 等符號標示；compliance 由 testing 確保或由 design 推導。
- Non-traceable specifications with limits（n. trc.）：依 specifications with limits 指定與測試，但因缺乏可追溯至 national metrology standards 的 measuring equipment，product performance 不保證。
- Specifications without limits：表示 warranted product performance；未特別標記時表示數值沒有或只有可忽略偏差。
- Typical data（typ.）：representative information；若標示 <、> 或 range，代表約 80% instruments 在 production time 可達成的 performance，其他情況代表 mean value。
- Nominal values（nom.）：representative value；production 期間不測試該 parameter。
- Measured values（meas.）：individual samples 的 measurement results。
- Uncertainties：coverage factor 2，依 Guide to the Expression of Uncertainty in Measurement（GUM），並考量 environmental conditions、aging、wear and tear。
- 來源明確說明：non-traceable specifications with limits、typical data、nominal values、measured values 不由 Rohde & Schwarz 保證。

TRI_AMD_RSKR Sharing1 › 重點摘要
- 來源正式發布日期未標示；raw frontmatter 僅標示 converted: 2026-09-18。Slide 8 頁尾另有 28/04/2020，應視為該 success story slide 的日期線索，不可套用到整份簡報。
- Slide 2 的 TRI case 題為 Test environment，圖中文字列出 4-port VNA [[R&S ZNB3044]]、[[R&S OSP320]]、DUT、flying probe module、interposer board，並寫明 ATE test scenario 是 dual-side capacity：test sides A and B 各量測 two DUTs，在 single inline measurement cycle 完成 full 4-DUT sequence。
- Slide 3 的 TRI case 題為 Test Result and capabilities，只能辨識 `< 5`，但來源未標示指標名稱、單位、測試條件或 pass/fail 門檻。
- Slide 4–5 的 AMD case 題為 Optimization for validation / Test result and stability proof。文字指出 default setup 在 40 GHz 以上 severe noise and uncertainty dominate the signal；optimized setup 則 complete signal stability unlocked up to 67 GHz；100 cycles continuous measurements 的 SDD12 distribution contained within +/- 3σ at 18.75 GHz。

The source should name the Semiconductor application or DUT, because existing Semiconductor-adjacent evidence only identifies Bare Board for SoCs, PCB probing, impedance, insertion loss, return loss, socket evaluation and transmission-line evaluation [39][46].
The source should name the exact R&S VNA solution and bundle, because existing project evidence names ZNB40, probe, mount-kit and de-embedding tool as the offered solution for PCB probing [46].
The source should name the exact competitor in the same use case, because existing competitor evidence names Keysight ENA only in the LSmtron board-to-board connector case [45].
Any R&S numeric claim needs the exact product, configuration and specification source, because ZNA67EXT is a 10 MHz to 110 GHz 1.0 mm VNA system based on ZNA67 with up to four external test sets [2][4].
Any ZNA67EXT claim must respect the stated configuration restriction, because its specifications apply only when the system configuration matches the R&S ZNA67 rear-panel designation scheme for type, serial numbers and correct port positions [4].
Any measurement-performance claim needs the stated test conditions, because ZNA67EXT product data assumes three hours of storage, 90 minutes of warm-up, specified environmental conditions, calibration interval compliance and applicable internal automatic adjustments [4].
Any dynamic-range comparison must use the same conditions, because ZNA67EXT dynamic range is specified at 10 Hz measurement bandwidth, with short-circuited test ports, no user correction, and specified port-pair limits only for port 1–2 and port 3–4 on 4-port models [7].
Any claim must separate warranted specifications from non-guaranteed data, because specifications with limits are warranted while typical data, nominal values, measured values and non-traceable specifications with limits are not guaranteed by R&S [4][38].
Competitor technical claims need official competitor evidence, because the Anritsu page says frequency range, bandwidth, data rate, option code, software tools and support model require Anritsu official datasheets, release notes or support terms for verification [23].
Sales-positioning claims should not be used as technical proof, because R&S superiority, only-vendor and lower-TCO statements are described as sales positioning rather than directly citeable technical specifications [23].
The 112G PAM4 PCB Engineering source is insufficient for a VNA comparison because it lacks test flow, instrument models, frequency range, fixture, calibration method, measurement values and pass/fail conditions [48].

ZNA_specs_en_5215-4652-22_v2400 › 規格條件與資料定義
- Specifications with limits：表示 warranted product performance；以 <、≤、>、≥、±、maximum、limit of、minimum 等符號標示；compliance 由 testing 確保或由 design 推導。
- Non-traceable specifications with limits（n. trc.）：依 specifications with limits 指定與測試，但因缺乏可追溯至 national metrology standards 的 measuring equipment，product performance 不保證。
- Specifications without limits：表示 warranted product performance；未特別標記時表示數值沒有或只有可忽略偏差。
- Typical data（typ.）：representative information；若標示 <、> 或 range，代表約 80% instruments 在 production time 可達成的 performance，其他情況代表 mean value。
- Nominal values（nom.）：representative value；production 期間不測試該 parameter。
- Measured values（meas.）：individual samples 的 measurement results。
- Uncertainties：coverage factor 2，依 Guide to the Expression of Uncertainty in Measurement（GUM），並考量 environmental conditions、aging、wear and tear。
